edition.publication: Four FDLC Collect-reflection leaflets for the 2012-2013 liturgical year, located through a Diocese of Evansville mirror. The edition-level source observation is dated 2026-08-21; the four exact mirror responses were fetched and hashed on 2026-08-26. Each file identifies ICEL's 2010 Roman Missal translation and states USCCB Committee on Divine Worship approval for the reprint, but the underlying authorization instrument and the publisher provenance of the mirrored bytes remain unresolved.
edition.title: Mystagogical Reflections on the Collects of the Roman Missal, Advent through Easter (FDLC, 2012-2013 series)

work.author: Federation of Diocesan Liturgical Commissions
work.description: The Federation of Diocesan Liturgical Commissions' free online leaflets are composite publications: FDLC compiles contributor-authored mystagogical reflections and design or artwork around excerpts identified by the leaflets as ICEL's 2010 English of the Roman Missal. The files state that the liturgical excerpts were reprinted with approval of the USCCB Committee on Divine Worship, but they do not identify the underlying authorization instrument or establish a right to redistribute the composite PDFs. The source library tracks text-free identity and remote artifact metadata only.
work.title: Mystagogical Reflections on Texts of the Roman Missal
